figures.title: 示例查询的几个部分
figures.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT s.supplier_id,COALESCE(a.ordered,0) ordered_cents,COALESCE(a.received,0) received_cents,COALESCE(b.billed,0) billed_cents,COALESCE(b.paid,0) paid_cents,COALESCE(b.balance,0) balance_cents FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN a ON a.supplier_id=s.supplier_id LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id ORDER BY balance_cents DESC

figures.title: 采购敞口：承诺、收货、开票、付款是不同的事件（供应商 2）

stages.label: ① 处理前：采购侧和财务侧各自先按供应商汇总（分）

tables.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT '订购承诺' item, ordered amount_cents FROM a WHERE supplier_id=2 UNION ALL SELECT '合格收货', received FROM a WHERE supplier_id=2
tables.name: 采购侧（v_po_lines）

tables.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT '净开票' item, billed amount_cents FROM b WHERE supplier_id=2 UNION ALL SELECT '已付款', paid FROM b WHERE supplier_id=2 UNION ALL SELECT '未付余额', balance FROM b WHERE supplier_id=2
tables.name: 财务侧（v_invoice_balance）

stages.label: ② 对齐成同一个供应商的一条“链”
stages.via: 各自先聚合到供应商，再对齐；未付余额是净开票减付款，并非未收货承诺

tables.sql: WITH a AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(ordered_cents) ordered,SUM(accepted*unit_price_cents) received FROM v_po_lines GROUP BY supplier_id), b AS (SELECT supplier_id,SUM(billed_cents) billed,SUM(paid_cents) paid,SUM(balance_cents) balance FROM v_invoice_balance GROUP BY supplier_id) SELECT item, amount_cents FROM (SELECT 1 n,'订购承诺' item, COALESCE(a.ordered,0) amount_cents FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN a ON a.supplier_id=s.supplier_id WHERE s.supplier_id=2 UNION ALL SELECT 2,'合格收货', COALESCE(a.received,0) FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN a ON a.supplier_id=s.supplier_id WHERE s.supplier_id=2 UNION ALL SELECT 3,'净开票', COALESCE(b.billed,0) FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id WHERE s.supplier_id=2 UNION ALL SELECT 4,'已付款', COALESCE(b.paid,0) FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id WHERE s.supplier_id=2 UNION ALL SELECT 5,'未付余额', COALESCE(b.balance,0) FROM suppliers s LEFT JOIN b ON b.supplier_id=s.supplier_id WHERE s.supplier_id=2) ORDER BY n

figures.conclusion: 金额不会一一对应：承诺 ≠ 收货 ≠ 开票 ≠ 付款，每一步之间的差额都是需要解释的业务事件。
